systems.country_label: SanteComTogo, national electronic Community Health Information System
systems.platform: Community Health Toolkit (CHT), designed by Medic
systems.owner: Ministry of Health; designed and deployed by Medic
systems.tiers: community health workers: launched March 2024 as a pilot in the Maritime Region, used by over 1,000 community health workers across six districts; national expansion planned

note: The only system is a community health worker app, a class noted and not assessed; the document says it refers patients to health centres but states no data exchange with an HMIS or EMR.
